t: Jimmy Shu's Taste of the Territory
d: The Top End of Australia has some of the best, freshest seafood in the country and in this episode Jimmy will show you why. Jimmy tells us that it was his search for Silver Barramundi that brought him to Darwin 29 years ago. He loved the place so much he decided to pick up his life and move. Jimmy takes us to meet one of his closest friends, long time fisherman Billy Boustead who lives at Shoal Ba

t: Jimmy Shu's Taste of the Territory
d: This week Jimmy heads 500km east of Darwin to the remote Arnhem Land coastal community of Maningrida. Jimmy visits Maningrida Wild Foods and goes out harvesting with local landowners for various bush foods that are now sold commercially. Traditional owner Leila Nimbadja shares stories from her childhood and takes Jimmy to hunt for long yam. Jimmy catches up with Don Wilton, one of only a few peopl
